topics.label: Lecture introduction and overview of cancer evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture, outlines the key learning objectives, and sets the conceptual framework for analyzing cancer progression as an evolutionary process.

topics.label: Genetic and epigenetic mechanisms of clonal selection
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how cell-intrinsic alterations, encompassing sequential driver mutations and non-mutational epigenetic remodeling, confer competitive growth advantages during clonal evolution.

topics.label: Cell of origin and cancer stem cell hierarchy
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate how normal tissue differentiation hierarchies and stemness properties influence cellular susceptibility to malignant transformation across different cancer types.

topics.label: Microenvironmental influences and integrated cancer evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate how inflammatory signals and stromal interactions promote tumor outgrowth, describe the spatial technologies used to profile these cellular interactions, and synthesize the multi-factorial evolutionary model of cancer.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and preview of cancer therapy
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the concluding framing for the session and announces the upcoming lecture topic on cancer therapy.
